sources.title: Piracy monthly report July 2025
sources.text: Four robbers armed with knives boarded an anchored ship. They threatened the duty OS & AB and tied them up. Officer on watch did not receive a response from the duty crew and immediately raised the alarm. Seeing the crew alertness, the robbers escaped with ship’s properties, ship’s stores, and crew personnel effects. The incident was reported to VTS.
